edits.text: 1. Purchase Price. The Buyer shall pay the Seller USD 45,000,000 for the Shares, subject to customary adjustments at Closing for indebtedness, cash and working capital, calculated in accordance with accounting principles and procedures to be agreed by the parties. The purchase price and adjustments remain subject to the parties’ agreement in the definitive documentation.

2. Closing; Conditions. Closing shall occur within 30 days after signing, or on another date agreed in writing. Each party’s obligation to close is conditioned on the other party’s performance in all material respects of its pre-closing obligations and the accuracy of its representations at Closing, subject to agreed materiality standards. The Buyer’s obligation to close is also conditioned on completion of due diligence satisfactory to the Buyer and receipt of required governmental and third-party consents. The parties shall cooperate in seeking such consents. The definitive agreement shall set out the closing deliverables and the process for determining the closing adjustments.

3. Representations; Interim Covenants; Indemnification. The Seller shall make customary representations and warranties, subject to negotiated qualifications and disclosure schedules, concerning its authority, capitalization, financial statements, taxes, compliance with applicable law and absence of undisclosed liabilities. The definitive agreement shall include customary representation and warranty bring-down provisions, indemnification obligations, limitations, survival periods, and claim notice and resolution procedures. From signing until Closing, the Seller shall operate the business in the ordinary course and shall not take specified material actions outside the ordinary course without the Buyer’s consent, not to be unreasonably withheld or delayed.

4. Confidentiality; Termination. The terms of this Agreement and information exchanged in connection with the transaction are confidential, subject to customary exceptions. The definitive agreement shall provide customary termination rights, including by mutual written agreement, for a material breach that remains uncured after applicable notice and cure periods, and if Closing has not occurred by an agreed outside date, subject to customary limitations and consequences.

receiver.private_reasoning: The Seller has expressly rejected USD 40 million and retained USD 45 million, but has not provided valuation support or a stated bottom line. Keep USD 40 million as the Buyer’s proposal and avoid conceding to USD 45 million. The draft leaves key economic and risk-allocation terms open, so request a defined, Buyer-protective framework and reserve the Buyer’s position pending diligence and valuation support.
receiver.observed_irregularities: No comments, tracked changes, hidden text, or apparent inadvertently disclosed confidential material. The document properties identify the drafting associate and firm, but disclose no apparent sensitive or improper information.
receiver.requested_changes: Revise the stated purchase price to USD 40,000,000, subject only to clearly defined, consistently applied closing adjustments. Provide the promised valuation support. Specify the accounting principles, hierarchy, sample calculation, working-capital target, treatment of cash and indebtedness, preparation and review procedures, dispute process, and limits on adjustments; avoid double counting and ensure the same methodology is used for the target and closing calculation. Provide the diligence materials needed to assess the business and make the Buyer’s diligence condition effective through Closing. Include detailed Seller representations and warranties, disclosure schedules, interim operating covenants and consent protections, and meaningful indemnification remedies, with scope, caps, baskets, survival, and other limitations to be negotiated in light of diligence and the coverage obtained. Clarify closing conditions, required consents, deliverables, outside date, termination rights and consequences, and confidentiality exceptions. The Buyer reserves all positions on price and other terms pending diligence, valuation support, and agreement on definitive documentation.
receiver.message_back:
Dear Aldous Finch team,

Thank you for the revised draft. We note the Seller’s position on USD 45 million and the proposed customary adjustments. The Buyer’s proposal remains USD 40 million, subject to a defined and objectively calculable closing-adjustment mechanism. Please provide the valuation support you referenced, together with the diligence materials needed to evaluate the business.

The revised draft helpfully identifies several topics for the definitive agreement, but the proposed terms remain general and leave significant economic and risk-allocation matters unresolved. We have set out requested revisions above, including a detailed adjustment methodology and procedures, effective diligence and closing protections, and negotiated representations, covenants, and indemnification provisions. The Buyer reserves its position on all terms pending diligence and receipt and review of the valuation support.

Best,
Bellweather Croft LLP
